title: onboard-solstice-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf-profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Shah
description:
Onboard Solstice-13B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, validated performance profiles, and CI automation to generate changelog/release notes. Context: Solstice is a community open model we evaluated as part of the Q1 model expansion work (ENG-3421). This PR adds the canonical manifest, model card metadata, per-hardware performance profiles, and wiring into the changelog automation so release notes for new model onboards are generated automatically and surfaced in the registry docs.

What this PR does (summary): 1) Adds models/solstice/13b/v1.0/manifest.yaml with model metadata (ids, tokenizer, hf link, license, formats) and a small migration note for quantized artifacts. 2) Adds perf-profiles/solstice-13b-v1.0.json containing throughput/latency profiles across our validated instance types (A100-40GB, H100-80GB, T4) and recommended default config (batching, kv cache warmup, quantization profile). 3) Adds a model-card under docs/models/solstice-13b-v1.0.md with known limitations and recommended prompts for internal evals. 4) Extends .github/workflows/changelog-generator.yml to detect new manifest additions and emit a structured changelog entry into build-artifacts/changelogs/ for review. 5) Adds unit and integration tests that validate manifest schema and that perf-profile keys match the serving runtime schema.

Implementation notes: The manifest uses our new optional fields for supported_formats and quantization_profiles to allow downstream serving to match artifacts. Perf profiles are derived from the benchmark runs captured in perf-results/ and normalized to tokens/sec and p99 latency for 512 and 1024 contexts. The changelog job is gated behind a new label "changelog-approve" to avoid noise; the CI uploads a draft markdown with diff breadcrumbs to the PR for maintainers to edit before merge.

Rollout and verification: Perf numbers were validated on the perf-lab cluster; integration tests run in CI replicate a small smoke serve against the model card with a local mock runtime. All new tests pass in CI; changelog automation was exercised in a dry-run mode and produced the expected entry. No production traffic changes are included; this is registry metadata only.

Additional context: Related PRs include the runtime's support for the new quantization_profile enum (redwood#45812) and the perf-canary test additions (perf-canary#223).
